canonical_run_selection_rule: For each calendar date in the window, the canonical production run is the UNIQUE pipeline_runs row with n_candidates>0 on that date (structural, outcome-blind: renquant105 intraday decisioning ticks are shadow-only and always produce n_candidates=0, so a real candidate-scoring session is a distinct, identifiable event). A date with ZERO such rows means no daily-full candidate-scoring session happened that day (excluded: no population to evaluate). A date with 2+ such rows is AMBIGUOUS -- no principled tie-break rule is available without additional ops context (e.g. which of two same-day scoring runs, if either, actually reflects the operative decision) -- excluded per fail-closed policy rather than picked by any heuristic, outcome-based or otherwise.

decision_ledger_db.consumed_from: scratchpad READ-ONLY copy of the live production decision ledger (sqlite); NOT included in this store (dynamic operational data, not a static research artifact) -- the exact rows this replay depends on are sealed below in canonical_run_manifest + candidate_rows + pipeline_run_metadata instead, so verification never requires DB access.

ohlcv_daily_close.consumed_from: local umbrella working copy RenQuant/data/ohlcv/<TICKER>/1d.parquet (READ-ONLY); only the exact (ticker, date) closes actually used are sealed below in ohlcv_closes -- verification never requires OHLCV file access.

purpose: Offline one-share-floor ON-vs-OFF replay over the production decision ledger, testing whether RS-2's floor-rescue mechanism (renquant-pipeline task_selection.py SizeAndEmitTask A-3 branch) would have rescued whole-share-rounded-to-zero candidates in the 2026-06-01..2026-07-10 window. r1 (orchestrator PR#471) picked, per calendar date, the run with the MAXIMUM deployment_delta_usd among ALL pipeline_runs rows for that date (up to 36/day, mostly zero-candidate renquant105 intraday decisioning ticks with n_candidates=0) as 'the representative session', and counted the denominator from ALL distinct run_dates rather than the same population. Codex review (2026-07-11): this is outcome-selected (look-then-select) and denominator-mismatched, not auditable. r2 fixes this: pre-declares exactly one canonical run_id per date via a STRUCTURAL rule blind to outcome (the unique pipeline_runs row with n_candidates>0 that date -- the real daily-full candidate-scoring session, distinct from the zero-candidate intraday ticks), fails closed (excludes, does not guess) on any date with zero or 2+ such rows, and filters both numerator and denominator to that exact predeclared population.
